name: Piglet processing
duplicates: The old UI (Figma 生产任务 › 仔猪处理) has a task-in-progress and a task-ended flow. The same litter-by-litter care is not drawn elsewhere, but piglet counts are also asked in Farrowing (born, dead).
flow: tap a pen (the sheet shows that pen's status)
tap the Task side of the summary card
tap the piglet count on a ticked item
tap Tag piglets, the ID item or the Tagged fact
tap Tag a piglet, or a piglet to fix it

notes.purpose: One row per pen (a pen is one sow with her litter) so the worker sees what each pen still needs and walks the pens.
states: One job: Shows only the pens that need one job today, so the worker can walk them with the treatment in hand. (tap a job chip (Iron, Dock tail, Castrate, Coccidiosis, Tag))
Done pens: Lists pens with nothing left to do. (tap the Done chip)
Farm without ID: Shows the list for fatteners raised as a batch, where no piglet gets an ID.
Two phones recorded the same job: Shows what the worker sees when another phone recorded the same treatment first.
Task ended: The same list after End: read-only. (after End task)

elements.name: Pen row
elements.shows: 000245 · To do · Iron · Castrate · Coccidiosis · Tag · 12 piglets · day 4 · 08:20 · G.H

states.when: Every step is still ahead (B05, B06)
states.shows: No chip; headline is the forecast "Iron tomorrow" / "Castrate in 2 days" (nearest start day)

states.when: Something is due and nothing is late
states.shows: Green "To do"; headline lists the steps still to do in plan order

states.when: Any step is past its window
states.shows: Amber "Late" (wins over the other chips); same headline

states.when: The sow died and no step is late
states.shows: Red "Sow died"; the pen stays on its schedule
Green "Done"; headline "12 piglets"; a pencil instead of the chevron
No chip; headline "Task ended"

elements.logic: Meta = piglets alive now · pen age in days · time (mm/dd if not today) of the pen's newest record · that worker as initial.surname-initial; the count is dropped when it is already the headline; pens with no record show just count and day. Plan order: Iron, Dock tail, Castrate, Coccidiosis, then the ID step.
elements.rule: One chip at most, one headline, one meta line (looks like farrowing's room list). Identity is owed only where the farm scheme requires it.
elements.source: penCard(); sowChip(); state.js status(), todo(), coming()

elements.name: Summary card · left half
elements.shows: Iron to do today · 6 · pens · Batch 40

states.when: Any pen needs a job today
states.shows: The first job in plan order that any pen needs, and how many pens need it
"Due today · 0 · nothing due"

states.when: Set count lowered some counts (task total above 0)
states.shows: Support line "Batch 40 · 3 piglets unaccounted"
Heading "Not done", the number of not-done pens, "pens"

elements.logic: "Needs today" = the step is due, late, or has piglets left from an earlier save. Only the first job is named even when other jobs have more pens.

elements.name: Summary card · right half
elements.shows: Task · 3 / 12 · pens done · Tap to end the task
elements.logic: Pens done over all pens, with a bar. A pen is done when it has nothing left to do today, which includes pens whose steps are all still ahead (B05, B06), so the figure overstates progress.

elements.name: Chips row
elements.shows: All 12 · Iron 6 · Dock tail 4 · Castrate 6 · Coccidiosis 6 · Tag 7 · Done 3

states.when: At least one pen needs the job today
states.shows: Shown with its pen count (due, late or some left)
Not drawn, unless it is the selected chip, which stays at 0
Named by the scheme (Tag, Notch, Breeders); absent on a No ID farm
Job chips are gone; All and Done remain

elements.rule: One radio group that only filters the list; bulk recording is not built.

elements.name: Latest line
elements.logic: The newest record of any kind on any pen (treatment, ID, death, move, count), its clock time and who; "Nothing recorded yet" when none. The time only, never the date.

edge: An empty filter prints "No pen needs this now." or "No pen is done yet."
Unseen two-phone notes appear as amber warnings under the latest line.
issues: "Done" pens include pens that have not started, so "3 / 12 pens done" overstates progress (HANDOFF open item 2).
The summary card names only the first job (Iron 6) while the chips show larger ones (Tag 7).
Chips only filter; the Round 9 ruling and HANDOFF describe tick-through pens and a hold, which are not built.
"Last record 08:20" has no date and can be yesterday's.
Pen code and sow ID are shown twice (header and row); the header says "1 sow" on every pen.
Home says Batch 27 / 8 pens / care due tomorrow; this list is Batch 40 / 12 pens / 6 pens due today.
No way back to Home.

screens.name: Pen sheet · nothing due yet
screens.zh: 栏位详情 · 还没到时间

notes.purpose: The pen sheet for a day-1 pen whose treatments start tomorrow.

elements.name: Age-day card
elements.shows: Day 2 · Planned 10/07 · Not due yet · can be done early

states.when: The day is today or earlier
states.shows: "Planned mm/dd" (today minus the gap between pen age and that day)
"Not due yet · can be done early"
The card disappears

elements.logic: One card per plan day: Iron and Dock tail day 2; Castrate, Coccidiosis and the ID step day 3.
elements.rule: Early is allowed for any scheduled item actually done and counts on time; the record is marked early.
elements.at: Not due yet · can be done early

issues: Everything is greyed as not due yet but nothing says when the first item opens except the list headline.

notes.purpose: Where the worker records a pen: tick what was done, adjust the count, submit once.

elements.name: Item row
elements.shows: Iron · day 2-4 · Castrate · Coccidiosis · Tag piglets · Not filled · 4 of 12 tagged

states.when: Pen age is inside the step's window (Iron and Dock tail days 2-4, Castrate 3-7, Coccidiosis 3-5, ID step 3-7)
states.shows: Open tick row with the window "day 2-4"

states.when: Pen age is past the window end
states.shows: Same row plus amber "late"; still tickable; the saved record carries the late mark

states.when: Pen age is before the window start
states.shows: Row under "Not due yet · can be done early"; a tick is allowed and the record is marked early

Check disc and the piglet count ("12 piglets" = alive minus already given) as a button into the count sheet; amber "early" if the day is later than pen age; amber "N left · reason" if the count was lowered; nothing is saved until Submit

states.when: A treatment was saved for fewer piglets than alive
states.shows: The rest stay on the list: "Iron · 10 given · 2 left · weak" (reason weak, sick, or "moved in" for arrivals)

states.when: The farm has an ID step
states.shows: Not ticked; opens the Piglets list. Meta amber "Not filled" / "Filled" (Filled once any ID exists; on a breeders-only farm once the pick is closed), progress words from the scheme ("4 of 12 tagged", "1 breeder picked"), "late" after day 7
Stays in its day card about four seconds after Submit, then folds into the Done card

elements.logic: Windows are in pen-age days (day 1 = born). Status per step: done when nothing is owed and it was given; left when some were given and some are owed; otherwise coming, due or late by pen age against the window. A death or Set count lowers alive; treatments given are capped at alive.
elements.rule: Late stays due, carries its real date and counts late. After End the ticks and Submit are gone and the sheet warns "Task ended. Nothing more can be recorded."
elements.source: dayItem(); state.js PLAN, status(), need(); sp.given.days, sp.late, sp.item.*

states.when: The day is today or earlier
states.shows: "Planned mm/dd" (today minus the gap between pen age and that day)
"Not due yet · can be done early"
The card disappears

elements.name: Piglets card
elements.shows: Boars · gilts 6 · 6 · Litter weight 24.6 kg · Tagged 4 of 12 · Breeders kept 1

states.when: Tag or notch farm and every alive piglet has an ID
states.shows: Counted from the IDs

states.when: Otherwise, a split was saved on the pen (Boars · gilts sheet)
states.shows: The saved split
The latest kg
"—" and the hint "Weigh the litter: growth figures need it."
The fact is labelled "Notched n of m"
Tagged and Breeders kept are not drawn; two facts remain

elements.logic: Each fact is a button into its own sheet. "n of m" = piglets with an ID over piglets alive; Breeders kept = IDs flagged as breeders. There is no separate piglets-alive figure: it is in the subtitle (born − dead, adjusted by deaths, moves and Set count).

elements.name: Tool row
elements.logic: Three tools as farrowing's row. The first is named by the farm scheme (Tag piglets, Notch piglets, Pick breeders) and is absent on a No ID farm; the whole row is hidden after End task.

states.shows: "Done · N items" and the names ("Iron · Dock tail")
Each row: "day 2 · G.H 10/05 08:05 · 12 piglets", amber early/late mark, and "yours kept as a note (hh:mm)" if another phone recorded first
Stays in its day card about four seconds before moving here

elements.name: Submit and Back
elements.logic: Submit saves every ticked item as one stamped record (who, when, count; marked early or late if outside its window), stays on the sheet, and shows "2 items saved · Undo" which takes those records back. Back drops unsaved ticks.
elements.rule: Submit is disabled at 0 ticks and absent after End task. Every treatment is one tap for all live piglets; lowering the number asks a reason for the rest.

edge: When another phone recorded the same item, the Done row says "yours kept as a note".
issues: The ticked count button ("12 piglets") looks like a value, not a control.
Dates in the day cards ("Planned 10/07") come from the pen's age, not from a farrowing date.
The Piglets card has four facts that are each a button into different sheets.

screens.name: Pen sheet · breeders-only farm
screens.zh: 栏位详情 · 只给种猪编号

notes.purpose: The same sheet when the farm tags only the piglets kept for breeding.

elements.name: Pick breeders step

states.shows: Amber "Not filled"; the step stays on the list

states.when: The worker closed the pick with Done picking (p.picked), even with no breeders
states.shows: Done; progress words "1 breeder picked"

elements.logic: Replaces the Tag piglets step and tool. The step's progress words are "N breeder(s) picked" instead of "n of m tagged"; the Piglets card is unchanged.

edge: A pick can close with no breeders ("Done picking · no breeders").

notes.purpose: A pen that missed a treatment window.

elements.name: Late item and record mark

states.when: Pen age is past the window end (B01, day 6)
states.shows: Amber "late" on the row, Late chip on the list, "late · day 6" on the End page; still tickable
The record is stamped late automatically; early is the mirror. No question is asked
Turns late

elements.rule: Late stays due until done or task end and counts late; no clinical cut-off in v1.

issues: The "missed" state of Round 2 Q15 is not shown; everything past its window is "late" forever.

screens.name: Pen sheet · all done
screens.zh: 栏位详情 · 全部完成

notes.purpose: A pen with every step recorded.

states.shows: "Done · N items" and the names ("Iron · Dock tail")
Each row: "day 2 · G.H 10/05 08:05 · 12 piglets", amber early/late mark, and "yours kept as a note (hh:mm)" if another phone recorded first
Stays in its day card about four seconds before moving here

elements.name: Empty line
elements.shows: Nothing left to do in this pen.

states.when: The pen has no day card left, whether or not it has done items (A01)
states.shows: The line, then the folded Done card

states.when: At least one step is still open or saved this visit
states.shows: Not drawn

elements.at: Nothing left to do in this pen.

edge: The tool row still offers Record death and More.
issues: Done items cannot be corrected here except by Undo within the visit; Edit was cut in the simplification (HANDOFF open item 1).

notes.purpose: Records that a treatment was given to fewer piglets than are alive in the pen.

elements.name: Piglets given and reason
elements.shows: Piglets given · Why fewer? Weak · Sick · Use 8

states.when: Count equals the number still to do
states.shows: No reason asked; "Use N" is enabled
"Why fewer?" (Weak, Sick) and "The other 2 stay on the list for later."; "Use N" stays disabled until a reason is chosen

states.when: The pen received piglets by a move
states.shows: The reason shown on the item is "moved in"

elements.logic: The stepper starts at the number still owed (alive minus given), minimum 1. The reason becomes the one shown on the item ("2 left · weak").
elements.rule: A skip carries a reason; deferred piglets stay due.

issues: Only two reasons (weak, sick); hernia, cryptorchid and "kept boar" exempt reasons from Round 2 are gone.

notes.purpose: Shows the pen's identified piglets and starts giving IDs.

elements.name: Piglet row

states.when: The piglet is flagged for breeding
states.shows: Green "Breeder" chip
Tag number, or notch number (litter-number-piglet); both if both exist

elements.logic: Headline is sex and optional weight; meta is time (only for today) and who tagged it. The group header reads "Tagged · 4 of 12 tagged · 1 breeder" ("Notched" on a notch farm).

elements.name: Flag button
elements.rule: Toggles breeder and stamps a record. Breeder selection may become a universal per-pig feature (Round 10); ranking is a placeholder.
elements.at: Tap the flag to keep it for breeding.

elements.name: Empty and primary
elements.shows: No piglet has an ID yet. · Tag a piglet

states.shows: "No piglet has an ID yet."; the hint is hidden
Secondary button "Done picking · N breeders" closes the pick; primary reads "Tag a breeder"
No flag, no primary, rows not tappable

elements.logic: Primary is named by scheme: Tag a piglet, Notch a piglet, Tag a breeder. The hint "Tap a piglet to fix it. Tap the flag to keep it for breeding." appears when at least one piglet has an ID and the task is open.

issues: "Tagged x of y" appears in the group, the Piglets card and the ID item meta: three places for one figure.

screens.name: Give IDs (one piglet at a time)

notes.purpose: Records one piglet's tag or notch, its sex and optionally its weight, then moves to the next.

elements.name: Tag readout
elements.logic: Prefilled with the next number on the strip (farm-wide highest tag + 1; strip starts at 001201). Typing replaces it, up to 6 digits. On a notch farm it is the pen's next piglet number (max 2 digits) and the saved ID is litter-number-piglet. Scan reads the next tag (demo). A cleared readout shows "—".
elements.rule: Record is blocked while the number is already on any pen of the farm ("001204 is already used.", refused tone).

elements.name: Sex and weight
elements.rule: Sex is required: Record stays disabled until one is chosen. Weight is optional, kg with one decimal, up to two integer digits.

states.shows: Saves at once (nothing waits for Submit) and returns a fresh form at the next number; "Last 001204 · Boar · 1.6 kg · Undo" shows the receipt
"Save change"; description "Fixing 001201"
The piglet is a breeder automatically; title "Pick breeders"
No primary

issues: No stop: after the last piglet the form keeps offering another; the number left ("8 without ID") is only in the description.
Sex is required here but the Round 1 Q3 ruling says sex and weight never block a row.

notes.purpose: Saves the litter's boar and gilt counts when not every piglet is identified.

elements.name: Boars and Gilts steppers
elements.logic: Starting values are the saved split, or counted from IDs when every piglet has one. Whole numbers from 0.
elements.rule: The sum is not checked against piglets alive.

issues: unclear: the sum is not checked against piglets alive.

notes.purpose: Records the weight of the whole litter on the day.

elements.name: Weight readout
elements.logic: Numpad, one decimal, up to 3 integer digits. Each save is appended as a new weigh kept with its pen age; the Piglets card shows the latest.
elements.rule: Save is disabled until the value is above zero.

issues: A second weighing on the same day is appended, not replaced as the glossary says.
No plausibility check (the glossary refuses over 6 kg per piglet).

notes.purpose: Holds the two rarer tools: Move piglets and Set count.
Records piglets that died, by cause.

elements.name: Cause steppers and Save
elements.shows: Crushed · Scours · Starve-out · Other · 3 piglets died
elements.logic: Each stepper is capped at the piglets alive; Save is disabled at a total of 0. Saving drops Alive by the total, raises Dead, caps treatments given at alive, and writes the log line "Died · 3".
elements.rule: Processing marks deaths through one shared dead picker that also lists tagged piglets (Round 1 Q9); this sheet is a count by cause and does not, so tagged piglets stay on the Piglets list.

edge: Individual tagged piglets are not picked as dead.
issues: This is a count-by-cause sheet, not the shared dead picker the ruling requires.

notes.purpose: Moves piglets to another pen of the batch and carries what they already had.

elements.name: To pen
elements.logic: One tile per other pen of the batch (pen age 1-6; here every other pen) with its day.
elements.rule: Move only offers pens in the task (and batch); no other room.

elements.name: Had treatment?

states.when: The source pen already gave a treatment
states.shows: One Yes/No per treatment; all must be answered before the primary enables

states.when: Tag or notch farm and the pen has IDs
states.shows: "Have tags?" / "Notched?"

elements.logic: "Don't know" of Round 2 Q14 is cut.

elements.name: Move N piglets
elements.logic: How many is a stepper from 1 to alive. A "had" answer shifts the given count to the receiving pen; otherwise the receiving pen marks the owed piglets "moved in".

issues: The Move does not suggest the receiving pen from time and room (Round 2 suggestion is cut).
Piglets identified before the move keep their tags but their IDs do not move to the new pen.

notes.purpose: Corrects the pen's piglet count to what is really there now.

elements.name: Piglets alive
elements.shows: Piglets alive · was 12 · Batch 40 · 3 piglets unaccounted
elements.logic: The drop (old minus new) is added to a task-level total shown as "N piglets unaccounted" on the list summary and in End task; a higher count lowers it. It is a batch checker, not a pen status. A treatment fully given stays fully given at the new count.
elements.rule: Set count just adjusts the pen's record to what is there now. No reason is asked and Save is disabled while unchanged.

issues: The unaccounted figure never shows which pen it came from.

notes.purpose: Shows every record of the pen as history, newest first by day.

elements.name: Log entries
elements.logic: Treatments, deaths, moves, counts, IDs, breeder picks and weights grouped by pen day (day 0 holds "Born 13" and "1 dead at birth"), with who and when (time if today, else mm/dd + time). Weight lines show no actor.

issues: Born is farrowing's number and cannot be seen or corrected from here; weight lines show no who or when.

notes.purpose: Reviews what is not done and ends the task by a hold.

elements.name: Not done list
elements.shows: A02 · Castrate · Coccidiosis · Tag · due today · 12 piglets

states.when: The pen has steps to do and none is late
states.shows: Headline the steps; meta "due today" and the largest owed piglet count among the treatments (the ID progress words if only the ID step is left)

states.when: Any step in the pen is late
states.shows: Meta amber "late · day 6" with the same count

states.when: Every step left is a partial treatment (status left) and no ID step
states.shows: Meta "2 left · weak" (or the reason given)
Group titled "Not given"; rows show the steps only, no meta

states.when: No pen has anything to do
states.shows: Progress meta "All pens done" and no list

elements.logic: No chips here (Late and Sow died appear on the pen list only). "3 of 12 pens done · 9 pens not done" uses the same done rule as the list, so pens not yet started count as done.

elements.name: Not due yet and Unaccounted
elements.shows: Not due yet in 2 pens: Iron, Dock tail. Ending the task stops these too. · 3 piglets unaccounted in this batch

states.when: Some pens have steps still ahead and the task is open
states.shows: Count of pens and the step names; hidden after End

states.when: Set count lowered counts so the total is above zero
states.shows: "N piglets unaccounted in this batch: counts came in lower than the records."

elements.at: Ending the task stops these too.

elements.name: Hold to end
elements.logic: Danger hold: the commit fires when the hold timer elapses, about 0.85 s (token --hold-commit, default 850 ms). Releasing, leaving the button, blur or Escape before that returns to idle without committing (holdStep in the design-system bundle). On commit the task is ended and the list becomes read-only.
elements.rule: Manual only, review in numbers, hold-to-commit (Round 1 Q5). End is allowed with review items open (Round 4). Ending should be blocked while the batch's farrowing task is open; that is not built.

edge: Always available: nothing checks that the batch's farrowing is closed.
issues: The ruling that End is blocked while farrowing is open is not built.
Not-yet-started pens are counted done and also listed under "Not due yet".
unclear: who may end (the code comment says the supervisor; no role check).
